semantic_review.basis: R03-R16 and R27 define input domain, selection, every validation case, success, renewed editing, Cancel, equal/unequal replacement and all callback boundaries; none is a hidden-only semantic.
Exact models/signatures and fixed copy are pinned by api-contract.json plus source/api; the caller bridges contain only decoding and real callback forwarding, with no remount or local product state.

Every prose clause and checkpoint sentence has responsibility and source pointer; every runtime obligation and source audit has a prose owner; every rule has applicable cells and obligation ownership.
Native runtime rules are labels, selection, enabled state, switch Boolean, conditional presence, native rectangles and dispatch-qualified callback intervals; computed font/padding are source-only.
Rendered canvas, rendered primary fill, content presence, wrapping and overlap are separate atoms; pixel policy has explicit original-image regions and channel tolerance.
Both routes have the same six checkpoint semantics and are inside the public width/text-size domain. Long data changes no public behavior or oracle definition.

scope: Exact prose ownership, typed source pointers, schema, matrix, routes, environments and launch manifests; manual semantic self-review by the design author; no SDK or independent second-person approval.
